caption: Paid plans run from $29.99 (2,500 clicks) to $79.99 a month and every plan bills extra recommendation clicks; the Free plan gives 50 clicks, then $0.026 each. The store name is hidden.
With the app embed on, the dashboard counts clicks against the Free plan's 50 a month; our test used 0. The store name is hidden.
We handpicked one upsell for The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard; the store name is hidden.
In the theme preview the offer appeared under Would you rather like these? with a Powered by Cross Sell link, which the Free plan keeps. The shop name is hidden.
On the Free plan only the upsell pop-up can be switched on; cart drawer, checkout, homepage and collection placements ask you to upgrade. The store name is hidden.
Start-up costs $29.99 every 30 days after a 14 day trial to 1 Dec. On our development store this was a test charge and we did not approve it; the store name is hidden.
The app's own menu has no cancel option, only Open app, View details, Get support and Uninstall.
